# Americonfort

> Americonfort is a premium car rental service in Morocco. Customers browse the fleet, choose pickup location and dates, and reserve vehicles online. Public address: Aéroport international Mohamed V, Casablanca.

The public website is a React application with a prerendered Casablanca airport landing page. Staff tools live under `/owner` and are not intended for general users or AI booking agents.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.americonfort.com/): Brand landing with search, featured vehicles, and company highlights
- [Cars](https://www.americonfort.com/cars): Full fleet listing with search and category filters (`pickupLocation`, `pickupDate`, `returnDate`, `category`)
- [Car details](https://www.americonfort.com/cars): Individual vehicles at `/car-details/:id` (only publicly visible cars)
- [Casablanca airport rental](https://www.americonfort.com/location-voiture-casablanca-aeroport): Local SEO landing for Mohammed V Airport car rental
- [About](https://www.americonfort.com/about)
- [Contact](https://www.americonfort.com/contact)
- [FAQ](https://www.americonfort.com/faq)
- [Terms](https://www.americonfort.com/terms)
- [Privacy](https://www.americonfort.com/privacy)
- [Insurance](https://www.americonfort.com/insurance)
- [Cookies](https://www.americonfort.com/cookies)
